summary: All 6 phases of the plan are substantially implemented. Phases 1-5 implementation commits were pushed (35f755aaf0). Phase 6 tests (807 lines across 4 files) were written but left uncommitted in the worktree — the coder stalled before committing and proposing. The implementation is sound: clean extraction of egg_restrictions shared package with backward-compatible re-exports, per-agent worktree isolation with {pipeline_id}-{role} naming, per-agent git identity, SDK tool interception (warn-only), and auto-commit removal with HITL recovery detection.

phase_1_extract_restrictions.detail: shared/egg_restrictions/ package created with patterns.py (651 lines, all 16 agent roles), checker.py (118 lines, AgentRestrictionResult + validation functions), and __init__.py with clean re-exports. gateway/agent_restrictions.py refactored to re-export from shared package (backward compatible). shared/pyproject.toml updated to include egg_restrictions*.

phase_2_per_agent_worktree.detail: container_spawner.py creates per-agent worktrees with ID '{pipeline_id}-{role}' at spawn time, falling back to shared volumes on failure. CONTAINER_ID env var is now per-agent. orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py updated. worktree_manager.py adds list_worktrees_for_pipeline(), cleanup_clean_worktree(), cleanup_stale_pipeline_worktrees(). Pipeline cleanup includes per-agent worktrees.

phase_3_per_agent_git_identity.detail: sandbox/entrypoint.py reads EGG_AGENT_ROLE, sets git identity to 'egg (<role>)' / '<role>@egg.local'. Falls back to 'egg' / 'egg@localhost' when no role set.

phase_4_sdk_tool_interception.detail: tool_interceptor.py implements check_file_write_permission() for Write/Edit/NotebookEdit. client.py integrates via intercept_tools parameter. Concern: warn-only, does not block tool calls. Acceptable for gradual rollout.

phase_5_remove_auto_commit.detail: auto_commit_worktree() is now a logged no-op. ~240 lines removed. detect_uncommitted_changes() added for HITL recovery. git_client.py updated with scoping comment.

phase_6_integration_tests.detail: 807 lines of tests across 4 files were written but left uncommitted (coder stalled). Tests cover per-agent worktree (325 lines), tool interceptor (202 lines), scoped push detection (162 lines), per-agent git author (118 lines). Well-structured with mocks and docstrings. Concern: never run or validated by tester.

behavioral_changes.change: Unknown agent roles now deny-by-default (was fail-open). Security improvement but behavioral change.
behavioral_changes.recommendation: Verify no existing agents with non-standard roles will be blocked.

behavioral_changes.change: Warn-only enforcement, does not block violating tool calls.
